# awscc_chime_channel_flow (Resource)

Creates a channel flow in the Amazon Chime SDK Messaging service. A channel flow is a container for processors (Lambda functions) that perform actions on chat messages.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_instance_arn` (String) The ARN of the app instance.
- `name` (String) The name of the channel flow.
- `processors` (Attributes List) Information about the processor Lambda functions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--processors))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags for the channel flow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `app_instance_id` (String) The ID of the app instance, extracted from the channel flow ARN.
- `arn` (String) The ARN of the channel flow.
- `channel_flow_id` (String) The ID of the channel flow, extracted from the channel flow ARN.
- `created_timestamp` (String) The time at which the channel flow was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_updated_timestamp` (String) The time at which the channel flow was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--processors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `processors`

Required:

- `configuration` (Attributes) A processor's metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--processors--configuration))
- `execution_order` (Number) The sequence in which processors run.
- `fallback_action` (String) Determines whether to continue or stop processing when communication with a processor fails.
- `name` (String) The name of the processor.

<a id="nestedatt--processors--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `processors.configuration`

Required:

- `lambda` (Attributes) Stores metadata about a Lambda processor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--processors--configuration--lambda))

<a id="nestedatt--processors--configuration--lambda"></a>
### Nested Schema for `processors.configuration.lambda`

Required:

- `invocation_type` (String) Controls how the Lambda function is invoked.
- `resource_arn` (String) The ARN of the Lambda message processing function.




<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key in a tag.
- `value` (String) The value in a tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_chime_channel_flow.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the channel flow

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_chime_channel_flow.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

$ terraform import awscc_chime_channel_flow.example "arn"
